The '''Wolf Guard''' is a military force comprised of former mercenaries and refugees turned soldiers sworn to [[Perrin Aybara]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wolf Guard|WG}} A select few serve Perrin's personal guard. 

They were trained by [[Tamlin al'Thor|Tam al'Thor]] and [[Dannil Lewin]] following the [[Battle of Malden]].{{ref||WG}}  The Wolf Guard utilize the [[Red Wolfhead Banner]] as their rallying insignia. They have been specially trained in the use of the [[Two Rivers Longbow]].

They fought honorably in the [[Tarmon Gai'don|Last Battle]] under Tam's command.{{ref||WG}}
